title: GST rates (slabs) explained
summary: What the GST slabs are and how to find the rate for your item.

sections.heading: What is a GST slab?
paragraphs: GST is charged at fixed rates. These rates are called slabs.
Each item or service falls under one slab. The rate on your bill depends on the item.

sections.heading: The current slabs
paragraphs: The slabs are in the box above, with their source.
Some items are taxed at zero. Others are taxed at higher rates. Check the rate for your own item before you bill.

sections.heading: How to find the rate for your item
paragraphs: Look up the item on the GST portal, or ask your CA.
Keep the rate in your billing record so you charge it the same way each time.
